name: branding-navy-fintech-pitch-deck-slide-collection
title: Navy and white brand pitch deck with italic serif emphasis and tab-like browser slide
whatItIs: A grid of about a dozen slides for a finance-app brand: a title with a large script wordmark, a table of contents, statement slides where one word is bold italic serif, a traction chart with a dotted line, palette swatches, a type specimen ('Aa' with weight list), a logo page and a browser bar mockup on navy.
whatItMeans: Refined and trustworthy; white space and a single navy give it institutional calm while italic serif adds personality.
techniques: Set one word per headline in italic serif for emphasis.
Repeat a thin header with brand keywords across slides.
Alternate white and navy slides to create rhythm.
Show type as a giant 'Aa' with a weight list.
Use a dotted-line chart with a light fill.

vocabulary.definition: Setting a key word in italic serif inside sans text.
A showcase of a typeface's forms and weights.
Small repeated text at the top of every slide.
Alternating slide colours to pace a deck.
